",
  "instructions": "仅合成数据，不是公司结论；人民币元，净收入/净销售额=订单实付减已记录退款， 不等于财务确认收入或毛利。订单日期为 Asia/Shanghai 业务 DATE，区间起含止不含， 退款归属原订单日。sales_orders 每行一订单，order_id 全局唯一； 客户身份必须使用 dept_id 和 customer_id。未匹配维度不丢订单。
sales_refunds 必须先按 dept_id、order_id 汇总退款，再 LEFT JOIN sales_orders。 无退款为零，计算一行一订单 paid_amount-COALESCE(refund_total,0)。 不关联 sales_order_lines 累计实付；不使用财务确认表替代净收入。
下单时行业来自 crm_industry_history，按 dept_id、customer_id 关联， 并要求 order_date>=valid_from AND order_date<valid_to。 无匹配保留为“未知行业”，有效期重叠必须由质量检查拒绝发布，不能改用当前行业代替。",

arguments.sql:
SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(*) AS industry_matches
FROM sales_orders o
JOIN crm_industry_history h ON o.dept_id = h.dept_id AND o.customer_id = h.customer_id AND o.order_date >= h.valid_from AND o.order_date < h.valid_to
WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY o.order_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(*) AS industry_matches
FROM sales_orders o
JOIN crm_industry_history h ON o.dept_id = h.dept_id AND o.customer_id = h.customer_id AND o.order_date >= h.valid_from AND o.order_date < h.valid_to
WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY o.order_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

WITH refunds AS (
  SELECT dept_id, order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_total
  FROM sales_refunds
  GROUP BY dept_id, order_id
), base_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.dept_id, o.customer_id, o.order_date,
         o.paid_amount - COALESCE(r.refund_total, 0) AS net_sales
  FROM sales_orders o
  LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.dept_id = r.dept_id AND o.order_id = r.order_id
  WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
), industry_orders AS (
  SELECT b.order_id, b.net_sales, COALESCE(h.industry, '未知行业') AS industry
  FROM base_orders b
  LEFT JOIN crm_industry_history h ON b.dept_id = h.dept_id AND b.customer_id = h.customer_id
    AND b.order_date >= h.valid_from AND b.order_date < h.valid_to
)
SELECT 'group' AS row_type, industry AS label, SUM(net_sales) AS amount
FROM industry_orders
GROUP BY industry
UNION ALL
SELECT 'total' AS row_type, '不重复总额' AS label, SUM(net_sales) AS amount
FROM base_orders

WITH refunds AS (
  SELECT dept_id, order_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_total
  FROM sales_refunds
  GROUP BY dept_id, order_id
), base_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.dept_id, o.customer_id, o.order_date,
         o.paid_amount - COALESCE(r.refund_total, 0) AS net_sales
  FROM sales_orders o
  LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.dept_id = r.dept_id AND o.order_id = r.order_id
  WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
), industry_orders AS (
  SELECT b.order_id, b.net_sales, COALESCE(h.industry, '未知行业') AS industry
  FROM base_orders b
  LEFT JOIN crm_industry_history h ON b.dept_id = h.dept_id AND b.customer_id = h.customer_id
    AND b.order_date >= h.valid_from AND b.order_date < h.valid_to
)
SELECT 'group' AS row_type, industry AS label, SUM(net_sales) AS amount
FROM industry_orders
GROUP BY industry
UNION ALL
SELECT 'total' AS row_type, '不重复总额' AS label, SUM(net_sales) AS amount
FROM base_orders

answer.reason: 单位：人民币元。仅为合成数据，不代表公司结论。统计订单日期为2026-01-01（含）至2027-01-01（不含）的订单；净销售额为实付金额减已记录退款，退款归属原订单日。退款先按部门、订单汇总；行业按部门、客户及下单日期匹配历史有效期，未匹配保留为未知行业。检查未发现本期订单匹配多个行业记录。总额从一行一订单的基础订单独立汇总，不重复计数；此口径不等于财务确认收入或毛利。
